notes.title: Zelle update ver1.3
notes.notes:
The app version of Zelle has been released this time, and a big update is coming!
But if you restart the game using past save data, a bug may occur depending on the restarted part. 
There is no problem if you start from NewGame, this update contains many program changes, so it is not possible to cover all existing save data. I apologize for any inconvenience, but please be careful when updating.

The contents of the update are as follows.
-Added 9 languages ​​in addition to Japanese and English.
-Added side screen for playing with a larger screen size.
-Added flashback scene with Reaper Zogzo.
-Improved overall performance.
-Other minor changes.

Thank you for your cooperation.
We are also considering a sale as well, so please take this opportunity to play.

An app version has also been released, so if you want to relax and play the game in bed, please check this out too!
zelle.odencat.com

Fuming

notes.title: Zelle update ver1.2
notes.notes:
Zelle update ver1.2 is here.
[strike]This update for mac is coming later.[/strike] 12/21/2019 Done
I changed some points as below.

-Performance
Changed nw.js ver into more stable version.
Some source code change.
Now not require much processing power than previous version.

-Battle
Randomize the position of correct rosary in most of battles.

-Add note 
"Record of Holy Warrior", "Record of conversation between Zogzo and Moon-faced Man".

-Graphic
Fixed some image processing.
There used to be some pixel graphics collapsed on some PCs.

Thank you in advance.
